title: Origins: Analgin Monster
description: The race feeds on pain: upon taking damage, it accumulates the resource "Pain" (0–100). It spends it on a healing pulse, pill form (invulnerability), combat boost, and regeneration. At 0 withdrawal (damage), at 100 overdose (poisoning). Vulnerable to magic
body:
Analgin Monster Race
Analgin Monster — a creature born from pain and painkillers. It feeds on suffering, converting damage taken into the resource "Pain," which it then uses to heal allies, gain temporary invulnerability, boost itself, and regenerate. This race requires the player to constantly balance between accumulating Pain and spending it, while also suffering severe consequences when the resource is depleted or maxed out.

Resource: Pain Gauge
Pain — a resource ranging from 0 to 100, displayed as a red bar.

Accumulation: Pain is automatically added upon taking any damage (fixed amount per hit).

Regeneration: The resource does not regenerate on its own — only through taking damage or using special items (if implemented).

Passive Abilities
Ability	Description
Pain Absorption	A portion of incoming damage is converted into Pain. The stronger the hit, the more Pain you gain (up to the maximum).
Pain Regeneration	If your health is not full and Pain is at least 30, you automatically spend 5 Pain to heal 1 heart. Triggers every 2 seconds.
Pain Withdrawal	When Pain drops to 0, your body begins to deteriorate — you lose 1 heart every second until you receive new Pain.
Overdose	Upon reaching 100 Pain, you suffer poison and weakness (effects last until Pain drops below 100).
Active Abilities
Ability	Key	Cost	Cooldown	Effect
Heal Pulse	Primary (G)	30 Pain	5 seconds	Heals all players within 10 blocks by 5 hearts. Accompanied by green particles and XP orb sounds.
Pill Form	Secondary (V)	20 Pain	10 seconds	For 5 seconds, you become tiny, gain complete invulnerability, but are slowed. Surrounded by dragon breath particles.
Pain Boost	Tertiary (B)	40 Pain	15 seconds	Gain Strength II and Speed II for 10 seconds. Effect accompanied by purple particles and potion sounds.
Weaknesses
Weakness	Description
Magic Vulnerability	You take double damage from magic sources (potions, magic projectiles, enchantments).
Pain Dependency	You cannot use regular healing potions — they have no effect on you (optional).
Visual & Sound Effects
As Pain accumulates, your skin becomes covered with pulsating red lines.

Using abilities triggers characteristic sounds: pill crunching, explosions, magical bursts.

Particles (hearts, shards, smoke) accompany each active ability.

Playstyle
Analgin Monster is the perfect choice for those who enjoy a support role with risk. You'll need to deliberately take hits to accumulate Pain, then wisely allocate it between saving allies, surviving, and boosting yourself in combat. Resource management discipline is the key to success.
